notes.title: UPDATE: My wrist is dead! X.X
notes.content:
Hello, my fans.
I have been working hard on a the first minigame for KO: Endless Wave mode. You fight enemies, forever, and ever, and ever. What score will you get? My highest is 53 with the bat queen Camilla.

I also finished and added the majority of Blue's animations to the game. He's a emo sadboy, but he's good with the guitar. Byooo woooo byooooo (sound effects coming soonish!)

Yarnhead has been nerfed to have less HP, however his summons have been buffed to be more aggressive and reliable kitty companions. His animations are also in the works.

The UI and menu has seen improvements, it should be easier to navigate now. There are more UI improvements planned in the future, unfortunately,  my wrist is in a lot of pain today from programming and animating a lot over a few days. I will need to take a break from game development for a couple days. I am buying wristbands and a vertical mouse and hopefully this happens less in the future. 

If you have taken the time to read this, I seriously seriously thank you.  KNOCKOFF has been programmed and animated entirely by me, plushcatboy, and it is my crybaby. This update announcement is the last thing I am going to do before logging off and giving myself a vacation, I typed it entirely with my pinky finger on my left hand. I need to keep myself away from the computer for a while! I love game dev, I am going to miss it.

-PLUSHCATBOY

notes.title: K.O. Full Game Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
A wise developer once said "a rushed game is forever bad, but a delayed game is someday good". While delays are always possible in game development, you can plan on seeing the full game of KNOCKOFF featuring between 6-10 characters, PvP, a story mode, mini games, and a roguelite mode releasing December 22nd, 2026.
That's all for now! Blue & Yarnhead full animations are coming soon.
PLUSHCATBOY

[b]Online Functionality[/b] is found in esc menu. 
After entering a stage and using the esc menu, use arrow keys to navigate to online then hit enter. Once inside lobby, hit create game then wait for your friend to hit find game. Once characters and stage is selected hit start game.
